'''Flavor syrup''' was a drink additive created by [[Nia Adea]]. With it, [[Gender/Legends|she]] helped boost the popularity of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Thirsty Bantha]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
